Two-motor synchronized tray mechanism

Actual V5 STL geometry, two 28BYJ-48 motors, two AS5600 sensors

Prototype model. Animation demonstrates ideal motion; it is not evidence of tested load capacity or zero backlash.

Drag to rotate the view. Blue: trays and their roll gears. Gold: shared pitch frame. Orange: motor pinions. Grey: base, motors and bearings. Green: sensors.

Pitch: one shared frame

The fixed motor drives the frame through a 4:1 gear reduction. Both tray centers lie on this pitch axis, so pitch does not raise one tray center above the other.

Roll: one drive, two outputs

The second motor travels on the frame. Its small pinion meshes with both tray gears, turning both trays in the same direction. Each tray retains its own roll axis.

Two output sensors

One sensor reads frame pitch. The other reads one tray’s roll relative to the frame. The second tray’s roll is mechanically coupled and is not independently measured.
